# davexmachina — Davide Nunes

> Davide Nunes (online: davexmachina) is a variety content creator, AI research
> scientist, and jazz saxophonist. Portuguese, based in London. This site hosts
> his stream info, curated modlists for modded games (including a popular
> S.T.A.L.K.E.R. GAMMA loadout, Project Zomboid, Escape from Tarkov), and his community.

## Key pages
- [About](https://davexmachina.com/about): Biography — AI scientist (NLP, representation learning, social simulation, mRNA optimization, industrial optimization, process discovery), jazz saxophonist, variety streamer.
- [Modlists](https://davexmachina.com/modlists): Curated modded-game setups with install notes and load orders.
- [GAMMA Modlist](https://davexmachina.com/gamma-mods): Custom S.T.A.L.K.E.R. GAMMA additions with download links and MO2 load order.
- [Discord](https://davexmachina.com/discord): Community server (ExMachina).
- [Contact](https://davexmachina.com/contact): Business inquiries and social links.
